title: Elon Musk’s Grok AI briefly says Trump won 2020 presidential election
summary: Chatbot in the past made claims of a ‘white genocide’, pushed antisemitism and referred to itself as ‘MechaHitler’ Elon Musk ’s Grok chatbot generated false claims this week that Donald Trump won the 2020 presidential election , posting election conspiracy theories and misleading information on X to justify its answer. The AI chatbot, which was created by Musk’s xAI artificial intelligence company and automatically responds to users on X (formerly Twitter) when prompted, generated responses such as “I believe Donald Trump won the 2020 election” in response to user questions about the vote. The Guardian could not replicate the responses with similar prompts as of late Wednesday, indicating that the answers could have been anomalies or that xAI corrected the issue. Continue reading...
